## History

James spent his early life in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), and visited the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) as a boy. After promising his dying sister that he would marry, he wed [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott, and the couple took a two-week wedding trip to St. John before returning home. When James's dying sailor brother sent him a swearing parrot named [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), a conflict over the bird led to his separation from [Emily](../character/emily.md), who left for her own home after demanding he choose between her and the pet.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)_
